description: A Rails 8 app that sends email, SMS, and in-app notifications with per-user preferences through Courier from an Active Job.
rules: Use the trycourier gem with require "courier", and call client.send_.message (send is reserved in Ruby).
Read COURIER_API_KEY from the environment on the server only. The browser gets a scoped JWT from auth.issue_token.
Pass one idempotency_key per event, such as order-<id>-shipped-<updated_at>, so Active Job retries never send twice.
Enqueue the send from an after_commit callback, not after_save.
Mint the inbox JWT for the user in the session, never a user id from params.
